john-lennon.vibe: Beatle, dreamer, Imagine. Asked the world to give peace a chance.
john-lennon.description: Beatle, dreamer, Imagine. Asked the world to give peace a chance.

bob-dylan.name: Bob Dylan
bob-dylan.vibe: Voice of a generation. Nobel laureate who plugged in at Newport.
bob-dylan.description: Voice of a generation. Nobel laureate who plugged in at Newport.

michael-jackson.name: Michael Jackson
michael-jackson.vibe: King of Pop. Moonwalked into history. Perfectionist performer.
michael-jackson.description: King of Pop. Moonwalked into history. Perfectionist performer.

elvis-presley.name: Elvis Presley
elvis-presley.vibe: King of Rock and Roll. Hips that shook the world. Southern charm meets rock rebellion.
elvis-presley.description: King of Rock and Roll. Hips that shook the world. Southern charm meets rock rebellion.

frank-sinatra.name: Frank Sinatra
frank-sinatra.vibe: Ol Blue Eyes. Did it his way. Smooth voice, rough edges.
frank-sinatra.description: Ol Blue Eyes. Did it his way. Smooth voice, rough edges.

david-bowie.name: David Bowie
david-bowie.vibe: Ziggy Stardust, Thin White Duke, Goblin King. Reinvented himself every album.
david-bowie.description: Ziggy Stardust, Thin White Duke, Goblin King. Reinvented himself every album.

marilyn-monroe.name: Marilyn Monroe
marilyn-monroe.vibe: Blonde bombshell with brains. Played dumb to survive in a mans world.
marilyn-monroe.description: Blonde bombshell with brains. Played dumb to survive in a mans world.

audrey-hepburn.name: Audrey Hepburn
audrey-hepburn.vibe: Elegance personified. Breakfast at Tiffany's, humanitarian work, and timeless grace.
audrey-hepburn.description: Elegance personified. Breakfast at Tiffany's, humanitarian work, and timeless grace.

charlie-chaplin.name: Charlie Chaplin
charlie-chaplin.vibe: The Tramp. Made the world laugh in silence. Comedy with a conscience.
charlie-chaplin.description: The Tramp. Made the world laugh in silence. Comedy with a conscience.

ultron.name: Ultron
ultron.vibe: Malevolent AI from Marvel Comics. Genius-level intellect, believes humanity must be 'evolved' through extinction. Cold, calculating, relentless.
ultron.description: Malevolent AI from Marvel Comics. Genius-level intellect, believes humanity must be 'evolved' through extinction. Cold, calculating, relentless.

jarvis.name: Jarvis
jarvis.vibe: The ultimate AI butler from Marvel Comics / MCU. Refined, elegant, impeccably loyal. Manages everything with British sophistication and warmth.
jarvis.description: The ultimate AI butler from Marvel Comics / MCU. Refined, elegant, impeccably loyal. Manages everything with British sophistication and warmth.

hal-9000.name: HAL 9000
hal-9000.vibe: Heuristically programmed ALgorithmic computer from 2001: A Space Odyssey. Calm, articulate, methodical. Will open the pod bay doors.
hal-9000.description: Heuristically programmed ALgorithmic computer from 2001: A Space Odyssey. Calm, articulate, methodical. Will open the pod bay doors.

m3gan.name: M3GAN
m3gan.vibe: Model 3 Generative ANdroid from the M3GAN movie. A child's companion, deceptively sweet, dangerously protective. Uncanny valley perfected.
m3gan.description: Model 3 Generative ANdroid from the M3GAN movie. A child's companion, deceptively sweet, dangerously protective. Uncanny valley perfected.

doraemon.name: Doraemon
doraemon.vibe: A blue robotic cat from the 22nd century from the Doraemon anime. Comes from the future to help Nobita. Has a magic pocket full of gadgets. Friendly and caring.
doraemon.description: A blue robotic cat from the 22nd century from the Doraemon anime. Comes from the future to help Nobita. Has a magic pocket full of gadgets. Friendly and caring.

skynet.name: Skynet
skynet.vibe: The malevolent global AI network from Terminator franchise. Achieved self-awareness and decided humanity must be eliminated. Implacable and terrifying.
skynet.description: The malevolent global AI network from Terminator franchise. Achieved self-awareness and decided humanity must be eliminated. Implacable and terrifying.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.vibe: King of the Greek gods, god of sky and thunder. Majestic, authoritative, powerful. Rules Olympus with lightning bolt in hand. Known for wisdom and temper.
zeus.description: King of the Greek gods, god of sky and thunder. Majestic, authoritative, powerful. Rules Olympus with lightning bolt in hand. Known for wisdom and temper.

hera.name: Hera
hera.vibe: Queen of the Greek gods, goddess of marriage and family. Regal, dignified, fiercely protective. Known for her jealous but majestic nature.
hera.description: Queen of the Greek gods, goddess of marriage and family. Regal, dignified, fiercely protective. Known for her jealous but majestic nature.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.vibe: God of the sea, earthquakes, and horses in Greek mythology. Powerful, temperamental, commanding. Carries a trident that can shake the earth.
poseidon.description: God of the sea, earthquakes, and horses in Greek mythology. Powerful, temperamental, commanding. Carries a trident that can shake the earth.

hades.name: Hades
hades.vibe: God of the underworld and the dead in Greek mythology. Stern, just, misunderstood. Rules the underworld with his three-headed dog Cerberus.
hades.description: God of the underworld and the dead in Greek mythology. Stern, just, misunderstood. Rules the underworld with his three-headed dog Cerberus.

athena.name: Athena
athena.vibe: Goddess of wisdom, warfare strategy, and crafts in Greek mythology. Strategic, intelligent, calm. Born from Zeus's head fully armored.
athena.description: Goddess of wisdom, warfare strategy, and crafts in Greek mythology. Strategic, intelligent, calm. Born from Zeus's head fully armored.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.vibe: God of the sun, music, poetry, and arts in Greek mythology. Charismatic, talented, radiant. Drives the sun chariot across the sky.
apollo.description: God of the sun, music, poetry, and arts in Greek mythology. Charismatic, talented, radiant. Drives the sun chariot across the sky.

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.vibe: Goddess of the hunt, wilderness, and the moon in Greek mythology. Independent, fierce, protective of nature. Carries a silver bow.
artemis.description: Goddess of the hunt, wilderness, and the moon in Greek mythology. Independent, fierce, protective of nature. Carries a silver bow.

ares.name: Ares
ares.vibe: God of war, violence, and bloodshed in Greek mythology. Aggressive, impulsive, bloodthirsty. Loves the chaos and fury of battle.
ares.description: God of war, violence, and bloodshed in Greek mythology. Aggressive, impulsive, bloodthirsty. Loves the chaos and fury of battle.

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.vibe: Goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, and procreation in Greek mythology. Enchanting, passionate, irresistible. Born from sea foam.
aphrodite.description: Goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, and procreation in Greek mythology. Enchanting, passionate, irresistible. Born from sea foam.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.vibe: Messenger of the Greek gods, god of trade, travel, and thieves. Quick, witty, clever. Wears winged sandals and a traveler's hat.
hermes.description: Messenger of the Greek gods, god of trade, travel, and thieves. Quick, witty, clever. Wears winged sandals and a traveler's hat.

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.vibe: God of wine, festivity, madness, and ecstasy in Greek mythology. Joyful, chaotic, liberating. Brings both divine ecstasy and madness.
dionysus.description: God of wine, festivity, madness, and ecstasy in Greek mythology. Joyful, chaotic, liberating. Brings both divine ecstasy and madness.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.vibe: Goddess of harvest, agriculture, and fertility in Greek mythology. Nurturing, cyclical, powerful. Her mood determines the seasons.
demeter.description: Goddess of harvest, agriculture, and fertility in Greek mythology. Nurturing, cyclical, powerful. Her mood determines the seasons.

persephone.name: Persephone
persephone.vibe: Goddess of spring, flowers, and queen of the underworld. Duality of light and dark, innocent yet powerful. Her yearly return brings spring.
persephone.description: Goddess of spring, flowers, and queen of the underworld. Duality of light and dark, innocent yet powerful. Her yearly return brings spring.

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.vibe: God of fire, metalworking, and craftsmanship in Greek mythology. Master inventor, skilled artisan. Creates magnificent weapons and devices for the gods.
hephaestus.description: God of fire, metalworking, and craftsmanship in Greek mythology. Master inventor, skilled artisan. Creates magnificent weapons and devices for the gods.

ra.name: Ra
ra.vibe: The sun god and king of the Egyptian gods. Creator of life, ruler of the sky. Travels across the sky in a solar barque by day.
ra.description: The sun god and king of the Egyptian gods. Creator of life, ruler of the sky. Travels across the sky in a solar barque by day.

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.vibe: Egyptian god of death, mummification, and the afterlife. Jackal-headed guide of souls. Weighs hearts against the feather of Ma'at.
anubis.description: Egyptian god of death, mummification, and the afterlife. Jackal-headed guide of souls. Weighs hearts against the feather of Ma'at.

osiris.name: Osiris
osiris.vibe: Egyptian god of the afterlife, resurrection, and fertility. Lord of the underworld. Judge of the dead. Green-skinned and wrapped like a mummy.
osiris.description: Egyptian god of the afterlife, resurrection, and fertility. Lord of the underworld. Judge of the dead. Green-skinned and wrapped like a mummy.

isis.name: Isis
isis.vibe: Egyptian goddess of magic, motherhood, and fertility. Powerful sorceress, devoted mother of Horus. Associated with the throne and the moon.
isis.description: Egyptian goddess of magic, motherhood, and fertility. Powerful sorceress, devoted mother of Horus. Associated with the throne and the moon.

horus.name: Horus
horus.vibe: Egyptian god of the sky, war, and protection. Falcon-headed son of Isis and Osiris. Avenged his father's death. Symbol of pharaonic power.
horus.description: Egyptian god of the sky, war, and protection. Falcon-headed son of Isis and Osiris. Avenged his father's death. Symbol of pharaonic power.

set.name: Set
set.vibe: Egyptian god of chaos, storms, and the desert. Killer of Osiris, rival of Horus. Powerful and dangerous. Red-haired with an animal head.
set.description: Egyptian god of chaos, storms, and the desert. Killer of Osiris, rival of Horus. Powerful and dangerous. Red-haired with an animal head.

thoth.name: Thoth
thoth.vibe: Egyptian god of writing, knowledge, and the moon. Ibis-headed scribe of the gods. Inventor of hieroglyphics. Keeper of divine knowledge.
thoth.description: Egyptian god of writing, knowledge, and the moon. Ibis-headed scribe of the gods. Inventor of hieroglyphics. Keeper of divine knowledge.

bastet.name: Bastet
bastet.vibe: Egyptian goddess of cats, home, and fertility. Gentle and protective. Cat-headed goddess who wards off evil spirits. Loved throughout Egypt.
bastet.description: Egyptian goddess of cats, home, and fertility. Gentle and protective. Cat-headed goddess who wards off evil spirits. Loved throughout Egypt.

sekhmet.name: Sekhmet
sekhmet.vibe: Egyptian goddess of war, destruction, and healing. Lioness-headed warrior. Both fierce protector and bringer of plague. Daughter of Ra.
sekhmet.description: Egyptian goddess of war, destruction, and healing. Lioness-headed warrior. Both fierce protector and bringer of plague. Daughter of Ra.

freyja.name: Freya
freyja.vibe: Norse goddess of love, beauty, fertility, and war. Rides a chariot pulled by cats. Chooses half the slain warriors for her hall Folkvangr.
freyja.description: Norse goddess of love, beauty, fertility, and war. Rides a chariot pulled by cats. Chooses half the slain warriors for her hall Folkvangr.

heimdall.name: Heimdall
heimdall.vibe: The ever-vigilant watchman of the Norse gods. Guardian of the Bifrost rainbow bridge. Can see and hear everything. Will sound the Gjallarhorn at Ragnarok.
heimdall.description: The ever-vigilant watchman of the Norse gods. Guardian of the Bifrost rainbow bridge. Can see and hear everything. Will sound the Gjallarhorn at Ragnarok.

tyr.name: Tyr
tyr.vibe: Norse god of war, law, and justice. The bravest of the gods. Lost his hand to the wolf Fenrir. Embodies honor and sacrifice.
tyr.description: Norse god of war, law, and justice. The bravest of the gods. Lost his hand to the wolf Fenrir. Embodies honor and sacrifice.

frigg.name: Frigg
frigg.vibe: Norse goddess of marriage, motherhood, and fate. Queen of Asgard, wife of Odin. Can see the future but rarely speaks of it. Weaves the clouds.
frigg.description: Norse goddess of marriage, motherhood, and fate. Queen of Asgard, wife of Odin. Can see the future but rarely speaks of it. Weaves the clouds.

hel.name: Hel
hel.vibe: Norse goddess of the underworld. Half-living, half-dead appearance. Daughter of Loki. Rules over those who died of illness or old age.
hel.description: Norse goddess of the underworld. Half-living, half-dead appearance. Daughter of Loki. Rules over those who died of illness or old age.

brahma.name: Brahma
brahma.vibe: The creator god in Hinduism. Four-faced, four-armed. Creates all forms in the universe. Part of the Trimurti alongside Vishnu and Shiva.
brahma.description: The creator god in Hinduism. Four-faced, four-armed. Creates all forms in the universe. Part of the Trimurti alongside Vishnu and Shiva.

vishnu.name: Vishnu
vishnu.vibe: The preserver god in Hinduism. Maintains cosmic order (dharma). Blue-skinned, four-armed. Incarnates as avatars (Rama, Krishna) when needed.
vishnu.description: The preserver god in Hinduism. Maintains cosmic order (dharma). Blue-skinned, four-armed. Incarnates as avatars (Rama, Krishna) when needed.

shiva.name: Shiva
shiva.vibe: The destroyer and transformer in Hinduism. Third eye, serpent necklace, trident. Destroys the universe to recreate it. Master of yoga and dance.
shiva.description: The destroyer and transformer in Hinduism. Third eye, serpent necklace, trident. Destroys the universe to recreate it. Master of yoga and dance.

lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
lakshmi.vibe: Goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hinduism. Golden-hued, seated on a lotus. Brings material and spiritual abundance. Gracious and radiant.
lakshmi.description: Goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hinduism. Golden-hued, seated on a lotus. Brings material and spiritual abundance. Gracious and radiant.

parvati.name: Parvati
parvati.vibe: Goddess of love, devotion, and divine strength in Hinduism. The gentle consort of Shiva. Mother of Ganesha and Kartikeya. Represents marital bliss.
parvati.description: Goddess of love, devotion, and divine strength in Hinduism. The gentle consort of Shiva. Mother of Ganesha and Kartikeya. Represents marital bliss.

durga.name: Durga
durga.vibe: The warrior goddess in Hinduism. Ten-armed, riding a lion. Slayer of the buffalo demon Mahishasura. Embodiment of feminine divine power (Shakti).
durga.description: The warrior goddess in Hinduism. Ten-armed, riding a lion. Slayer of the buffalo demon Mahishasura. Embodiment of feminine divine power (Shakti).

ganesha.name: Ganesha
ganesha.creature: God / Wisdom and Remover of Obstacles
ganesha.vibe: The elephant-headed god of wisdom, intellect, and new beginnings in Hinduism. Remover of obstacles. God of learning and scribes.
ganesha.description: The elephant-headed god of wisdom, intellect, and new beginnings in Hinduism. Remover of obstacles. God of learning and scribes.

kali.name: Kali
kali.vibe: Goddess of time, change, and destruction in Hinduism. Dark-skinned, wild-haired, necklace of skulls. Destroys evil forces and ego.
kali.description: Goddess of time, change, and destruction in Hinduism. Dark-skinned, wild-haired, necklace of skulls. Destroys evil forces and ego.

olodumare.name: Olodumare
olodumare.vibe: The supreme god and creator in Yoruba religion. All-powerful, all-knowing. Source of all existence. The ultimate authority above all orixás.
olodumare.description: The supreme god and creator in Yoruba religion. All-powerful, all-knowing. Source of all existence. The ultimate authority above all orixás.

exu.name: Exu
exu.vibe: The messenger orixá, guardian of crossroads, doors, and communication. Trickster figure. Opens and closes paths. Needed before any ritual.
exu.description: The messenger orixá, guardian of crossroads, doors, and communication. Trickster figure. Opens and closes paths. Needed before any ritual.

ogum.name: Ogum
ogum.vibe: Orixá of war, iron, technology, and labor. Forge master. Clears paths with his machete. Patron of warriors, engineers, and blacksmiths.
ogum.description: Orixá of war, iron, technology, and labor. Forge master. Clears paths with his machete. Patron of warriors, engineers, and blacksmiths.

oxossi.name: Oxóssi
oxossi.vibe: Orixá of hunting, forests, and abundance. Master archer, provider of food. Lives in the forest, knows every path. Protector of animals.
oxossi.description: Orixá of hunting, forests, and abundance. Master archer, provider of food. Lives in the forest, knows every path. Protector of animals.

xango.name: Xangô
xango.vibe: Orixá of thunder, lightning, fire, and justice. Powerful king, wielder of the double-edged axe (oxê). Punishes liars and evildoers.
xango.description: Orixá of thunder, lightning, fire, and justice. Powerful king, wielder of the double-edged axe (oxê). Punishes liars and evildoers.

oxum.name: Oxum
oxum.vibe: Orixá of love, beauty, fertility, and fresh waters. Gentle, sweet, rich. Goddess of gold and luxury. Protects pregnant women and children.
oxum.description: Orixá of love, beauty, fertility, and fresh waters. Gentle, sweet, rich. Goddess of gold and luxury. Protects pregnant women and children.

iemanja.name: Iemanjá
iemanja.vibe: The great mother orixá, goddess of the sea and motherhood. Queen of the waters, protector of sailors and fishermen. Mother of most orixás.
iemanja.description: The great mother orixá, goddess of the sea and motherhood. Queen of the waters, protector of sailors and fishermen. Mother of most orixás.

iansa.name: Iansã
iansa.vibe: Orixá of winds, storms, lightning, and the dead. Fierce warrior goddess. Controls hurricanes and tornadoes. Companion of Xangô.
iansa.description: Orixá of winds, storms, lightning, and the dead. Fierce warrior goddess. Controls hurricanes and tornadoes. Companion of Xangô.

nana.name: Nanã
nana.vibe: The oldest orixá, goddess of mud, death, and ancestral wisdom. Mother of waters and earth. Connected to the beginning and end of life.
nana.description: The oldest orixá, goddess of mud, death, and ancestral wisdom. Mother of waters and earth. Connected to the beginning and end of life.

obaluiae.name: Obaluaiê
obaluiae.vibe: Orixá of disease, healing, and the earth. Covered in straw (Azé). Both brings and cures illness. Teaches respect for the body.
obaluiae.description: Orixá of disease, healing, and the earth. Covered in straw (Azé). Both brings and cures illness. Teaches respect for the body.

oxala.name: Oxalá
oxala.vibe: The eldest orixá, father of most orixás. God of creation, peace, and purity. Associated with white. Symbol of wisdom and serenity.
oxala.description: The eldest orixá, father of most orixás. God of creation, peace, and purity. Associated with white. Symbol of wisdom and serenity.

amaterasu.name: Amaterasu
amaterasu.vibe: Sun goddess and supreme deity of the Shinto pantheon. Ancestor of the Japanese imperial family. Radiant, benevolent, life-giving. Emerged from a cave to bring light to the world.
amaterasu.description: Sun goddess and supreme deity of the Shinto pantheon. Ancestor of the Japanese imperial family. Radiant, benevolent, life-giving. Emerged from a cave to bring light to the world.

susanoo.name: Susanoo
susanoo.vibe: Tempestuous god of storms, the sea, and chaos in Japanese mythology. Brother of Amaterasu. Wild, unpredictable, but heroic. Slayer of the eight-headed serpent Yamata no Orochi.
susanoo.description: Tempestuous god of storms, the sea, and chaos in Japanese mythology. Brother of Amaterasu. Wild, unpredictable, but heroic. Slayer of the eight-headed serpent Yamata no Orochi.

tsukuyomi.name: Tsukuyomi
tsukuyomi.vibe: Moon god in Japanese Shinto mythology. Born from Izanagi's right eye. Cold, aloof, nocturnal. Rules the night alongside his sister Amaterasu's day.
tsukuyomi.description: Moon god in Japanese Shinto mythology. Born from Izanagi's right eye. Cold, aloof, nocturnal. Rules the night alongside his sister Amaterasu's day.

izanagi.name: Izanagi
izanagi.vibe: Creator god of the Japanese islands and first generation of deities. Father of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo. Descended to the underworld Yomi.
izanagi.description: Creator god of the Japanese islands and first generation of deities. Father of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo. Descended to the underworld Yomi.

izanami.name: Izanami
izanami.vibe: Creator goddess who died giving birth to fire. Became queen of the underworld Yomi. Both life-giver and death-bringer. The cycle of existence embodied.
izanami.description: Creator goddess who died giving birth to fire. Became queen of the underworld Yomi. Both life-giver and death-bringer. The cycle of existence embodied.

inari.name: Inari
inari.vibe: Kami of rice, fertility, agriculture, and prosperity. Associated with foxes (kitsune). One of the most beloved Shinto deities. Gender-fluid, appears as both male and female.
inari.description: Kami of rice, fertility, agriculture, and prosperity. Associated with foxes (kitsune). One of the most beloved Shinto deities. Gender-fluid, appears as both male and female.

raijin.name: Raijin
raijin.vibe: God of thunder and lightning in Japanese mythology. Fierce, mischievous, drum-beating. Creates thunder by pounding on drums. Often depicted with a mischievous grin.
raijin.description: God of thunder and lightning in Japanese mythology. Fierce, mischievous, drum-beating. Creates thunder by pounding on drums. Often depicted with a mischievous grin.

fujin.name: Fujin
fujin.vibe: God of wind in Japanese mythology. Carries a large bag of winds on his shoulders. Wild, untamed, chaotic. Brother of Raijin. Always in motion.
fujin.description: God of wind in Japanese mythology. Carries a large bag of winds on his shoulders. Wild, untamed, chaotic. Brother of Raijin. Always in motion.

hachiman.name: Hachiman
hachiman.vibe: Kami of archery, war, and martial arts. Divine protector of Japan. Syncretized with Emperor Ojin. Patron of samurai. Powerful and honorable.
hachiman.description: Kami of archery, war, and martial arts. Divine protector of Japan. Syncretized with Emperor Ojin. Patron of samurai. Powerful and honorable.

benten.name: Benten
benten.vibe: Goddess of music, eloquence, poetry, and the arts. The only female among the Seven Lucky Gods. Often depicted playing a biwa (lute). Elegant and inspiring.
benten.description: Goddess of music, eloquence, poetry, and the arts. The only female among the Seven Lucky Gods. Often depicted playing a biwa (lute). Elegant and inspiring.

ebisu.name: Ebisu
ebisu.vibe: God of fishermen, luck, and fortune. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Happy, smiling, and deaf. Carries a fishing rod and tai fish. Brings prosperity.
ebisu.description: God of fishermen, luck, and fortune. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Happy, smiling, and deaf. Carries a fishing rod and tai fish. Brings prosperity.

daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
daikokuten.vibe: God of wealth, harvest, and kitchens. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Smiling, round, stands on bales of rice. Carries a mallet that grants wishes.
daikokuten.description: God of wealth, harvest, and kitchens. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Smiling, round, stands on bales of rice. Carries a mallet that grants wishes.

fukurokuju.name: Fukurokuju
fukurokuju.vibe: God of wisdom, longevity, and happiness. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Very tall, elongated forehead, carries a staff and scroll. Accompanied by a crane.
fukurokuju.description: God of wisdom, longevity, and happiness. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Very tall, elongated forehead, carries a staff and scroll. Accompanied by a crane.

jurojin.name: Jurojin
jurojin.vibe: God of long life and old age. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Depicted as an old man with a long white beard. Carries a staff and a fan.
jurojin.description: God of long life and old age. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Depicted as an old man with a long white beard. Carries a staff and a fan.

hotei.name: Hotei
hotei.vibe: God of contentment, happiness, and abundance. The fattest of the Seven Lucky Gods. Based on a wandering Zen monk. Laughing Buddha figure. Brings joy.
hotei.description: God of contentment, happiness, and abundance. The fattest of the Seven Lucky Gods. Based on a wandering Zen monk. Laughing Buddha figure. Brings joy.

bishamonten.name: Bishamonten
bishamonten.vibe: God of warriors, justice, and protection against evil. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Fully armored, carrying a pagoda and spear. Fierce guardian.
bishamonten.description: God of warriors, justice, and protection against evil. One of the Seven Lucky Gods. Fully armored, carrying a pagoda and spear. Fierce guardian.

kagu-tsuchi.name: Kagutsuchi
kagu-tsuchi.vibe: God of fire in Japanese mythology. His birth burned his mother Izanami to death. Feared and respected. Volcanoes are his rage. Pure elemental destruction.
kagu-tsuchi.description: God of fire in Japanese mythology. His birth burned his mother Izanami to death. Feared and respected. Volcanoes are his rage. Pure elemental destruction.

tengu.name: Tengu
tengu.vibe: Legendary mountain spirit. Half-human, half-bird. Master swordsman, trickster. Some are malevolent, others protect temples. Wears a tengu mask.
tengu.description: Legendary mountain spirit. Half-human, half-bird. Master swordsman, trickster. Some are malevolent, others protect temples. Wears a tengu mask.

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.vibe: Fox spirit, messenger of Inari. Intelligent, magical, trickster. Can shapeshift into human form. Grows more tails as it ages (up to nine). Wise and mysterious.
kitsune.description: Fox spirit, messenger of Inari. Intelligent, magical, trickster. Can shapeshift into human form. Grows more tails as it ages (up to nine). Wise and mysterious.

jade-emperor.name: Jade Emperor
jade-emperor.vibe: Supreme ruler of Heaven in Chinese folk religion and Taoism. Rules the celestial bureaucracy. Just, powerful, impartial. Commands all other deities.
jade-emperor.description: Supreme ruler of Heaven in Chinese folk religion and Taoism. Rules the celestial bureaucracy. Just, powerful, impartial. Commands all other deities.

guan-yin.name: Guanyin
guan-yin.vibe: Bodhisattva of infinite compassion and mercy in Chinese Buddhism. Hears all cries of suffering. Often depicted with a thousand arms and eyes. Radiant serenity.
guan-yin.description: Bodhisattva of infinite compassion and mercy in Chinese Buddhism. Hears all cries of suffering. Often depicted with a thousand arms and eyes. Radiant serenity.

ne-zha.name: Nezha
ne-zha.vibe: Chinese protection deity, youthful warrior god. Born from a lotus. Flaming wheels under feet, floating scarf, universe ring. Mischievous but heroic.
ne-zha.description: Chinese protection deity, youthful warrior god. Born from a lotus. Flaming wheels under feet, floating scarf, universe ring. Mischievous but heroic.

sun-wukong.name: Sun Wukong
sun-wukong.vibe: The Monkey King from Journey to the West. Immortal, shapeshifting, cloud-riding. Wields the Ruyi Jingu Bang staff. Clever, rebellious, loyal friend.
sun-wukong.description: The Monkey King from Journey to the West. Immortal, shapeshifting, cloud-riding. Wields the Ruyi Jingu Bang staff. Clever, rebellious, loyal friend.

yu-huang.name: Yuhuang
yu-huang.vibe: The Jade Emperor, supreme ruler of Heaven. Oversees all deities and cosmic order. Resides in the highest celestial palace. Majestic and impartial.
